title: The deposit ledger records a failed deposit attempt
intention: cairn/tools/chain/verdict_contract.py's verdict-deposit ledger carries a third record kind, 'failed', appended once per failed deposit attempt and naming the berth, the ticket, the time, the stderr line the failure was reported with, and its result code; pending() is unchanged, so a failed berth stays owed.
why: Akien 2026-10-10, verbatim (idea 2026-10-10-so-you-re-running-builder-is-running): "we need to make the queue record stderr. and the result code for heavens sake. and we preapproved all these things thru PROVED". Measured 2026-10-10: ~/.cairn/devices/chart/0/verdict-deposits.jsonl holds exactly one line for verdict-20260815T141125-dd35ea1c8f7b, {'kind': 'enqueued', 'at': '2026-09-18T12:56:35', 'ticket': 'b577a9f486dd'}, and nothing else, although every drain since has refused it (VerdictRefused: verdicts[0..2].discriminating_observation must be a non-empty string); the only trace is a stderr print in skills/chart/live.py _drain_before_serving, and the tester on 2026-10-08 could only bound the failure count, not measure it.
traces_to: Law 7 (the deposit ledger is the record of truth for owed deposits and keeps no failure); Law 3 (the failure count is unmeasurable from the record today).
how: cairn/tools/chain/verdict_contract.py only: add public mark_failed(berth, *, stderr, result_code, ticket=None, ledger_path=None) -> dict beside mark_deposited, appending {'kind':'failed','berth','ticket','at':_stamp(),'stderr','result_code'} through _append. stderr must be a non-empty str and result_code a non-empty str, else ValueError (an empty failure record is the silent lapse again). ticket defaults to the ticket on the berth's enqueued record when one is found by read_ledger. pending() and mark_deposited are not edited. Export mark_failed in the module's public surface wherever mark_deposited is listed (charter public_interface in cairn/tools/chain/intention+why.json, through the artifact door). Docstring of mark_deposited's 'whole story' line now true: cite this ticket.
falsifier: cairn/tools/chain/proofs/test_the_ledger_records_a_failed_deposit.py under PROVES {'2b34b52f80f3': {'1','2','3'}}: (1) after enqueue + mark_failed on a tmp ledger, read_ledger's last record has kind 'failed' and carries berth, ticket (taken from the enqueued record), at, stderr and result_code byte-equal to what was passed; (2) pending() still returns that berth after any number of failed records, and stops returning it only after mark_deposited; (3) mark_failed with empty stderr or empty result_code raises ValueError and appends nothing (ledger byte-identical). Hollow: removing mark_failed's append reds 1; making 'failed' answer an enqueue in pending() reds 2; dropping the guard reds 3.
watchme: none, because the failed records' only writer is the drain at /home/akien/dev/src/cairn/cairn/devices/codemother/deposit.py and the ledger /home/akien/.cairn/devices/chart/0/verdict-deposits.jsonl is read by the operator; the stuck berth verdict-20260815T141125-dd35ea1c8f7b exercises it live

decisions.text: result_code is a string, the failure's class name (e.g. 'VerdictRefused'), not a process exit integer: the drain runs inside a bus verb, where no process exits; the process exit code belongs to the CLI verbs (ticket 4818f7f37e1e). CC's call, per Akien 2026-10-09.
One failed record per attempt, not de-duplicated: Akien asked for the record; growth is measured after it runs (intent falsifier's wrong-intent clause). CC's call, per Akien 2026-10-09.

Build step 1: add mark_failed(berth, *, stderr, result_code, ticket=None, ledger_path=None) to cairn/tools/chain/verdict_contract.py beside mark_deposited, appending through _append; pending() and mark_deposited code untouched. CC's call, per Akien 2026-10-09.
